root_cause_summary: Seven failures/errors came from non-isolated temporary fixtures: they wrote JSON files under episodes/_tests but the active episode_meta_store/runtime review persistence uses configured MySQL authority, so production readers correctly did not see those file-only fixtures.

One runtime expectation depended on host availability: with WebCodex host evidence absent and a Codex CLI installed, HEAD applies the existing deterministic CODEX fallback, while the test assumed WORK without mocking the host environment.

related_prior_changes.area: episode metadata persistence migrated to MySQL/Redis repositories
WORK/WebCodex unavailable fallback to configured Codex CLI

failures.name: test_default_runtime_is_work
failures.cause: The test did not isolate WebCodex availability or Codex CLI presence. Commit 120f8133 enables deterministic CODEX fallback when the configured WebCodex workspace is unavailable and Codex CLI is installed.

failures.name: test_legacy_visual_review_work_branch_never_calls_codex
failures.cause: The test asserted a local JSON file while the configured episode-meta persistence backend is MySQL; the fixture did not select JSON test mode or query the persistence facade.

failures.name: test_pending_story_review_outranks_stale_preimage_handoff
failures.cause: The fixture wrote episode-state.json directly, but active episode metadata authority is MySQL and no corresponding temporary Episode row was seeded.

failures.name: test_preimage_verify_host_request_reconciles_from_valid_handoff
failures.cause: The fixture wrote current/history request JSON directly while the active request/metadata persistence path reads MySQL-backed state; the temporary fixture was not isolated to JSON compatibility mode.

failures.name: test_second_attempt_guard_resolves_legacy_alias_only
failures.assertion: attempt-1 request file can be renamed to legacy alias
failures.cause: Review persistence is MySQL-backed under the active config, so prepare() does not materialize the attempt request file expected by this file-manipulation fixture.

failures.name: test_redundant_story_review_residue_is_suppressed_and_reported
failures.cause: The test manually wrote request residue files, but the active MySQL review persistence reader enumerates repository records rather than these unregistered temporary JSON files.

failures.name: test_stale_frame_contract_index_routes_to_deterministic_recompile
failures.cause: next_host_step reads episode stage from the configured MySQL metadata authority, but this fixture only created a local JSON stage file.

failures.name: test_stale_preimage_committed_snapshot_routes_back_to_task_set
failures.cause: next_host_step did not observe the fixture's local STORYBOARD_LOCKED file because the active Episode stage authority is MySQL.
